newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume fell at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold a total of 396 shares at 1,000 denars, unchanged from Tuesday's close and below par of 2,423 denars.
Traded volume was 779 shares at the previous session on Tuesday when only Alkaloid stocks traded at 1,000 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
